SELECT DISTINCT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date
FROM tb_order
AND create_time >= #{start}
AND create_time <= #{end}
AND status IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY date

SELECT SUM(amount) as amount FROM tb_order
AND create_time >= #{start}
AND create_time <= #{end}
AND status IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m')
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT p.partner_name as name, COUNT(vm.id) as value FROM tb_partner p LEFT JOIN tb_node n ON p.id = n.partner_id LEFT JOIN tb_vending_machine vm ON n.id = vm.node_id GROUP BY p.id, p.partner_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT vm.id as id, vm.inner_code as innerCode, vm.addr as addr, vm.update_time as updateTime, vt.name as vmTypeName, CONCAT('{"key": "', vm.running_status, '","value":"', CASE vm.running_status WHEN '{\"statusCode\":\"1001\",\"status\":true}' THEN '正常' ELSE '异常' END, '" }') as runningStatus FROM tb_vending_machine vm LEFT JOIN tb_vm_type vt ON vm.vm_type_id = vt.id WHERE vm.running_status != '{\"statusCode\":\"1001\",\"status\":true}' OR vm.running_status IS NULL ORDER BY vm.update_time DESC
